en.s: The Hammadid–Zirid War was the first in a series of conflicts between Hammadid and Zirid forces. It lasted from Hammad's removal of allegiance to the Fatimid Caliph and his submission to the Abbasids in 1014 until the recognition of Hammadid independence with the treaty between the two dynasties on 5 January 1018.

zh.t: 哈马德王朝与齐里王朝战争
zh.s: 哈马德王朝与齐里王朝战争，是两者一系列冲突中的第一场。战争始于1014年哈马德不再效忠法蒂玛王朝哈里发、转而臣服阿拔斯王朝，终于1018年1月5日两王朝签订条约，承认哈马德王朝独立。

en.s: The Battle of Kunovica or Battle at Kunovitsa (Serbian: Битка на Куновици) was the battle between crusaders led by John Hunyadi and armies of the Ottoman Empire which took place on 2 or 5 January 1444 near mountain Kunovica (Suva Planina) between Pirot and Niš.

zh.s: 1444年1月2日或5日，匈雅提·亚诺什率领的十字军与奥斯曼帝国军队，在皮罗特与尼什之间的库诺维察山附近交战。库诺维察属于苏瓦山脉。

en.s: The Battle of Nancy was the final and decisive battle of the Burgundian Wars, fought outside the walls of Nancy on 5 January 1477 by Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy, against René II, Duke of Lorraine, and the Swiss Confederacy. René's forces won the battle, and Charles' mutilated body was found three days later.

zh.s: 1477年1月5日，勃艮第公爵大胆查理在南锡城墙外，与洛林公爵勒内二世及瑞士邦联军交战。这是勃艮第战争的最后一场、也是决定性的战役。勒内的军队获胜，三天后人们发现了查理残缺不全的尸体。

en.s: The Olonets expedition (Swedish: Olonetsexpeditionen; Russian: Олонецкая экспедиция) was an invasion towards Olonets executed by Generalmajor Erik Kruse during January 1657 as part of the Russo-Swedish War of 1656–1658. Despite not capturing Olonets like he intended, Erik Kruse destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed all civilians he encountered, drawing condemnations from people like Per Brahe the Younger.

zh.s: 奥洛涅茨远征（瑞典语：Olonetsexpeditionen；俄语：Олонецкая экспедиция）是1656年至1658年俄瑞战争的一部分，由埃里克·克鲁泽少将于1657年1月向奥洛涅茨发动进攻。他未能按计划攻占奥洛涅茨，却摧毁了数百座建筑，并杀害了途中遇到的所有平民，受到包括小佩尔·布拉赫在内的人士谴责。

en.s: The Battle of Khajuha was fought on January 5, 1659, between the newly crowned Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb and Shah Shuja who also declared himself Mughal Emperor in Bengal. Shuja's army rested by the tank of Khajwa, about 30 miles to the west of Fatehpur- Haswa in'the Allahabad District, between the Ganges and the Jumna.

zh.s: 1659年1月5日，新近加冕的莫卧儿皇帝奥朗则布与同样在孟加拉自称莫卧儿皇帝的沙舒贾爆发卡朱哈战役。舒贾的军队当时驻扎在卡朱哈水池旁，地点位于阿拉哈巴德地区、恒河与亚穆纳河之间，在法泰赫普尔—哈斯瓦以西约30英里。

en.s: The Battle of Turckheim was a confrontation during the Franco-Dutch War fought on 5 January 1675 between the towns of Colmar and Turckheim in Alsace. The French army, commanded by the Viscount of Turenne, fought against the armies of Austria and Brandenburg, led by Frederick William, Elector of Brandenburg.

zh.s: 1675年1月5日，法荷战争中的蒂尔凯姆战役，在阿尔萨斯的科尔马与蒂尔凯姆两镇之间展开。蒂雷纳子爵指挥法军，迎战勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈·威廉率领的奥地利与勃兰登堡军队。

en.s: Turenne's winter campaign took place during the Franco-Dutch War of 1672-78. During December 1674 and January 1675, Henri de la Tour d'Auvergne, Vicomte de Turenne, led French forces on a flank march that resulted in the defeat of an army fielded principally by the Holy Roman Empire and in that army's expulsion from Alsace.

zh.s: 蒂雷纳冬季战役发生于1672年至1678年的法荷战争期间。1674年12月至1675年1月，蒂雷纳子爵亨利·德·拉图尔·多韦涅率法国军队进行迂回侧翼机动，击败了一支主要由神圣罗马帝国组成的军队，并将其逐出阿尔萨斯。

en.t: Louis XV of France survives an assassination attempt by Robert-François Damiens, who becomes the last person to be executed in France by drawing and quartering (the traditional form of capital punishment used for regicides)
en.s: Louis XV (15 February 1710 – 10 May 1774), known as Louis the Beloved (French: le Bien-Aimé), was King of France from 1 September 1715 until his death in 1774. He succeeded his great-grandfather Louis XIV at the age of five. Until he reached maturity (then defined as his 13th birthday) in 1723, the kingdom was ruled by his grand-uncle Philippe II, Duke of Orléans, as Regent of France.

zh.t: 法国国王路易十五遇刺生还，刺客达米安后来成为法国最后一名被车裂处死的人，车裂原为弑君者的传统刑罚
zh.s: 路易十五（1710年2月15日—1774年5月10日）被称为“受爱戴的路易”（法语：le Bien-Aimé），自1715年9月1日起担任法国国王，直至1774年去世。他五岁时继承曾祖父路易十四的王位。在他于1723年满13岁、达到当时规定的成年年龄之前，法国由其叔祖父奥尔良公爵腓力二世摄政。

en.t: January 1789 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The January 1789 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 5 January 1789. The election followed the death of incumbent Speaker Charles Wolfran Cornwall. William Wyndham Grenville was nominated by the Earl of Euston and seconded by William Pulteney. Sir Gilbert Elliot was nominated by Welbore Ellis and seconded by Frederick Montagu. Both candidates addressed the House.

zh.s: 1789年1月5日，英国下议院举行议长选举，填补现任议长查尔斯·沃尔弗兰·康沃尔去世留下的空缺。威廉·温德姆·格伦维尔由尤斯顿伯爵提名、威廉·普尔特尼附议；吉尔伯特·埃利奥特爵士由韦尔博尔·埃利斯提名、弗雷德里克·蒙塔古附议。两名候选人都在议院发表了讲话。

en.s: The Treaty of the Dardanelles (also known as the Dardanelles Treaty of Peace, Commerce, and Secret Alliance, the Treaty of Çanak, the Treaty of Chanak or Turkish: Kale-i Sultaniye Antlaşması) was concluded between the Ottoman Empire and Great Britain on 5 January 1809 at Çanak, Ottoman Empire. The treaty ended the Anglo-Turkish War. The Porte (the Ottoman government) restored extensive British commercial and legal privileges in the empire.

zh.s: 《达达尼尔海峡条约》又称《达达尼尔海峡和平、通商及秘密同盟条约》或《恰纳克条约》（土耳其语：Kale-i Sultaniye Antlaşması），由奥斯曼帝国与英国于1809年1月5日在奥斯曼帝国恰纳克缔结。条约结束了英土战争，奥斯曼政府恢复了英国在帝国内广泛的商业与法律特权。

en.s: The Battle of Puruarán was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 5 January 1814 in the area around Puruarán, Michoacán. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents were commanded by Mariano Matamoros y Guridi and the Spanish by Agustín Cosme Damián de Iturbide y Arámburu who would later go on to become the Mexican emperor, and by Ciriaco del Llano. The battle lasted approximately one hour and resulted in a victory for the Spanish Royalists.

zh.s: 1814年1月5日，墨西哥独立战争中的普鲁阿兰战役在米却肯州普鲁阿兰周边展开。忠于西班牙王室的保王军与争取独立的墨西哥起义军交战。起义军由马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯-古里迪指挥，西班牙一方则由阿古斯丁·科斯梅·达米安·德·伊图尔维德-阿兰布鲁与西里亚科·德尔利亚诺指挥；伊图尔维德后来成为墨西哥皇帝。战斗持续约一小时，最终保王军获胜。

en.t: The government of Central America votes for total annexation to the First Mexican Empire
en.s: Central America is a subregion of North America. Its political boundaries are defined as bordering Mexico to the north, Colombia to the southeast, the Caribbean to the east, and the Pacific Ocean to the southwest. Central America is usually defined as consisting of seven countries: Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama, and also, in specialized contexts, including Mexico.

zh.t: 中美洲政府投票决定全部并入墨西哥第一帝国
zh.s: 中美洲是北美洲的一个次区域，其政治地理范围北接墨西哥，东南邻哥伦比亚，东临加勒比海，西南濒太平洋。中美洲通常指伯利兹、哥斯达黎加、萨尔瓦多、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜和巴拿马七国；在某些特定语境中也包括墨西哥。

en.s: The 1829 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 5, 1829, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. National Republican nominee and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates Daniel Martin was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Democratic nominee George E. Martin.

zh.s: 1829年1月5日，马里兰州举行州长选举。国家共和党候选人、前州众议员丹尼尔·马丁经州议会选举，当选州长，击败民主党候选人乔治·E.马丁。

en.s: The 1835 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 5, 1835, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent National Republican governor James Thomas was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against candidates Joshua Jones and Joseph Weast.

zh.s: 1835年1月5日，马里兰州举行州长选举。国家共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·托马斯经州议会选举获得连任，击败候选人约书亚·琼斯和约瑟夫·韦斯特。

en.s: The 1846 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the first of two elections to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1845. The new constitution abolished the provision in the 1812 constitution that required a gubernatorial candidate to win a vote of the legislature to get elected, leaving the final decision up to the people.

zh.s: 1846年路易斯安那州州长选举，是依据1845年州宪法举行的两次选举中的第一次。新宪法废除了1812年宪法中州长候选人须经议会投票才能当选的规定，将最终决定权交给选民。

en.s: On January 5, 1855, during the Liberal Revolution of 1854 in Peru, at the La Palma hacienda, Ramón Castilla's troops defeated those of Echenique, who had to be sheltered in the house of the British charge d'affaires, Sullivan. The Government Palace, the President's house and his wife's quinta were looted, as well as that of his relatives and his closest collaborators. Echenique then went into exile.

zh.s: 1855年1月5日，秘鲁1854年自由革命期间，拉蒙·卡斯蒂利亚的军队在拉帕尔马庄园击败埃切尼克的部队。埃切尼克不得不躲进英国代办沙利文的住所。政府宫、总统住宅、其妻的乡间宅邸，以及亲属和亲信的房屋都遭到洗劫。此后，埃切尼克流亡国外。

en.s: The 1858 Victoria colonial by-election was held on 5 January 1858 to elect the member for Victoria in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Robert Rowland Leake resigned on 8 December 1857. George Charles Hawker won the by-election unopposed.

zh.t: 1858年维多利亚选区殖民地议会补选
zh.s: 1858年1月5日，南澳大利亚众议院维多利亚选区举行补选，填补现任议员罗伯特·罗兰·利克于1857年12月8日辞职留下的空缺。乔治·查尔斯·霍克在没有竞争对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The Battle of Hancock, also called the Romney Campaign, was a battle fought during the Romney Expedition, occurred January 5–6, 1862, in Washington County, Maryland, and Morgan County, West Virginia, as part of Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's operations against the Baltimore and Ohio (B&O) Railroad during the American Civil War. On January 1, 1862, Confederate general Stonewall Jackson led his men from Winchester to Bath in an attempt to disturb traffic on the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad and the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal. Jackson's men reached the Potomac River opposite the garrisoned town of Hancock, Maryland on January 5, after a skirmish with Union soldiers.

zh.s: 1862年1月5日至6日，汉考克战役在马里兰州华盛顿县及西弗吉尼亚州摩根县展开，也称罗姆尼战役，是美国内战中托马斯·“石墙”·杰克逊少将针对巴尔的摩与俄亥俄铁路展开的罗姆尼远征的一部分。1月1日，杰克逊率邦联军从温彻斯特前往巴斯，试图扰乱铁路及切萨皮克与俄亥俄运河的运输。与联邦军小规模交战后，他的部队于1月5日抵达波托马克河岸，对岸就是有驻军防守的马里兰州汉考克镇。

en.t: The Palais Garnier, one of the most famous opera houses in the world, is inaugurated in Paris
en.s: The Palais Garnier (French: [palɛ ɡaʁnje] , "Garnier Palace"), also known as Opéra Garnier (French: [ɔpeʁa ɡaʁnje] , "Garnier Opera"), is a historic 1,979-seat opera house at the Place de l'Opéra in the 9th arrondissement of Paris, France. It was built for the Paris Opera from 1861 to 1875 at the behest of Emperor Napoleon III.

zh.t: 世界著名歌剧院之一巴黎加尼叶歌剧院揭幕
zh.s: 加尼叶歌剧院又称加尼叶宫（Palais Garnier）或Opéra Garnier，是法国巴黎第九区歌剧院广场上一座历史悠久的歌剧院，设有1,979个座位。它奉拿破仑三世之命为巴黎歌剧院建造，施工时间为1861年至1875年。

en.s: The 1891 Calgary municipal election was scheduled for January 5, 1891 to elect a Mayor and six Councillors to sit on the seventh Calgary Town Council from January 5, 1891, to January 18, 1892.

en.s: Auburn, Alabama municipal elections are held every four years to elect the mayor of the city and members of the city council. A runoff election is held if no candidate receives a majority of the votes, in both mayoral and city council elections.
en.n: This entry records Auburn’s January 5, 1901 municipal election, not every later election discussed in the article.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州奥本市每四年举行一次市政选举，选出市长及市议会议员。在市长和市议会选举中，若没有候选人获得过半数选票，就会举行第二轮决选。

en.t: Kappa Alpha Psi is founded at Indiana University Bloomington
en.s: Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc. (ΚΑΨ) is a historically African American fraternity. Since the fraternity's founding on January 5, 1911, at Indiana University Bloomington, it has never restricted membership based on color, creed, or national origin, though membership traditionally is dominated by black men. The fraternity has over 260,000 members with 721 undergraduate and alumni chapters in every state of the United States, and international chapters in ten countries.

zh.t: 卡帕·阿尔法·普赛兄弟会在印第安纳大学布卢明顿校区成立
zh.s: 卡帕·阿尔法·普赛兄弟会（Kappa Alpha Psi，ΚΑΨ）是一个具有非裔美国人历史背景的大学兄弟会。自1911年1月5日在印第安纳大学布卢明顿校区成立以来，它从未因肤色、信仰或原籍而限制入会，尽管传统上会员以黑人男性为主。兄弟会拥有超过26万名会员，在美国各州设有721个本科生及校友分会，并在另外十个国家设有国际分会。

en.t: The sixth All-Russian conference of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party opens in Prague
en.s: The Russian Social Democratic Labour Party (RSDLP), also known as the Russian Social Democratic Workers' Party (RSDWP) or the Russian Social Democratic Party (RSDP), was a socialist political party founded in 1898 in Minsk, Russian Empire. The party emerged from the merger of various Marxist groups operating under Tsarist repression, and was dedicated to the overthrow of the autocracy and the establishment of a socialist state based on the revolutionary leadership of the Russian proletariat.
en.n: January 5 is the Julian-calendar opening date recorded by this entry; it corresponds to January 18, 1912 in the Gregorian calendar. The conference continued through January 17 Julian / January 30 Gregorian. This is not the original formation of the Bolshevik faction.

zh.t: 俄国社会民主工党第六次全国代表会议在布拉格开幕
zh.s: 俄国社会民主工党（RSDLP，也译俄国社会民主劳动党，亦有RSDWP和RSDP等缩写）是1898年在俄罗斯帝国明斯克成立的社会主义政党。该党由在沙皇镇压下活动的多个马克思主义团体合并而成，致力于推翻专制制度，在俄国无产阶级的革命领导下建立社会主义国家。
zh.n: 此条记录采用儒略历开幕日期1月5日，对应公历1912年1月18日。会议持续至儒略历1月17日，即公历1月30日。这不是布尔什维克派最初形成的日期。

en.t: The Ford Motor Company announces an eight-hour workday and minimum daily wage of $5 in salary plus bonuses
en.s: The Ford Motor Company (commonly known as Ford, sometimes abbreviated as FoMoCo) is an American multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Dearborn, Michigan, United States. It was founded by Henry Ford and incorporated on June 16, 1903. The company sells automobiles and commercial vehicles under the Ford brand, and luxury cars under its Lincoln brand.

zh.t: 福特汽车公司宣布实行八小时工作制，工资加奖金的每日最低报酬为5美元
zh.s: 福特汽车公司通常简称福特，有时缩写为FoMoCo，是总部位于美国密歇根州迪尔伯恩的跨国汽车制造商。亨利·福特创立了该公司，并于1903年6月16日完成公司注册。公司以福特品牌销售汽车和商用车，以林肯品牌销售豪华汽车。

en.s: The Second Battle of Edea was the German counter-attack against French forces stationed in the village of Edea during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War. Allied forces from Duala occupied the town following the First Battle of Edea in October 1914. The Germans, eager to retake the position attacked on 5 January 1915 but were repulsed by the French force.

zh.s: 第二次埃代阿战役发生于第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间，是德军对驻扎在埃代阿的法军发动的反攻。1914年10月第一次埃代阿战役后，来自杜阿拉的协约国部队占领了该镇。1915年1月5日，德军为夺回阵地发动进攻，但被法军击退。

en.s: The Januszajtis putsch of early January 1919 was an unsuccessful coup d'etat in Poland. On 4–5 January 1919, right-wing National Democrats attempted to overthrow the government of Jędrzej Moraczewski and Józef Piłsudski. The coup's leaders included Marian Januszajtis-Żegota and Prince Eustachy Sapieha. The coup forces succeeded in arresting Moraczewski's government but not Piłsudski.

zh.s: 1919年1月初的亚努沙伊蒂斯政变，是波兰一场未遂政变。1月4日至5日，右翼民族民主派试图推翻延杰伊·莫拉切夫斯基与约瑟夫·毕苏斯基的政府。政变领导人包括马里安·亚努沙伊蒂斯-热戈塔和尤斯塔希·萨皮耶哈亲王。政变部队成功逮捕了莫拉切夫斯基政府成员，但未能逮捕毕苏斯基。

zh.s: 1919年1月的维尔纽斯战役（波兰语：Walki o Wilno；俄语：Сражения за Вильно）是在维尔纽斯进行的一系列战斗。亲波兰的立陶宛与白俄罗斯自卫部队，先于1918年12月31日至1919年1月3日对抗从城内撤退的德意志帝国军队及布尔什维克准军事组织，随后于1月4日至5日迎战进攻的红军。

en.s: The 1918 Copa Aldao was the final match to decide the winner of the Copa Aldao, the fourth edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Argentine Racing Club de Avellaneda and Uruguayan club Peñarol. The match was played at Gimnasia y Esgrima Stadium in Buenos Aires, and Racing beat Peñarol 2–1, winning its second Copa Aldao trophy in three consecutive finals contested.

zh.s: 1918年阿尔道杯是阿根廷与乌拉圭两国足协联合主办的国际赛事的第四届决赛，由阿根廷阿韦亚内达竞技俱乐部对阵乌拉圭佩纳罗尔俱乐部。比赛在布宜诺斯艾利斯的体操与击剑体育场举行，竞技队以2比1取胜，在连续参加三届决赛后，第二次捧起阿尔道杯。

en.s: The German Workers' Party (German: Deutsche Arbeiterpartei, DAP) was an obscure far-right political party established in the Weimar Republic after World War I. It lasted from 5 January 1919 until 24 February 1920. The DAP was the precursor of the National Socialist German Workers' Party (German: Nationalsozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei, NSDAP), commonly known as the Nazi Party.

zh.s: 德国工人党（德语：Deutsche Arbeiterpartei，简称DAP）是第一次世界大战后在魏玛共和国成立的一个名不见经传的极右翼政党，存续于1919年1月5日至1920年2月24日。它是国家社会主义德国工人党（Nationalsozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei，简称NSDAP），即通常所称纳粹党的前身。

en.s: The Battle of Daugavpils, or Battle of Dyneburg, or Operation Winter was a battle during the Polish–Soviet War. A joint Polish and Latvian force, operating under Polish Staff orders known as "Operation Winter", attacked the Red Army garrison in Dunaburg, or Daugavpils, from 3 to 5 January 1920. From the Polish perspective, the battle was part of the Polish–Soviet War.

zh.s: 陶格夫匹尔斯战役又称迪纳堡战役或“冬季行动”，是波苏战争期间的一场战斗。波兰与拉脱维亚联军依据波兰参谋部下达的“冬季行动”命令，于1920年1月3日至5日进攻迪纳堡（即陶格夫匹尔斯）的红军驻军。从波兰的角度看，这场战斗属于波苏战争的一部分。

en.t: Construction of the Golden Gate Bridge begins in San Francisco Bay
en.s: The Golden Gate Bridge is a suspension bridge spanning the Golden Gate, the one-mile-wide (1.6 km) strait connecting San Francisco Bay and the Pacific Ocean in California, United States. The structure links San Francisco—the northern tip of the San Francisco Peninsula—to Marin County, carrying both U.S. Route 101 and California State Route 1 across the strait. It also carries pedestrian and bicycle traffic, and is designated as part of U.S. Bicycle Route 95.

zh.t: 旧金山湾金门大桥开工
zh.s: 金门大桥是美国加利福尼亚州一座横跨金门海峡的悬索桥。海峡宽约一英里（1.6公里），连接旧金山湾与太平洋。大桥将旧金山半岛北端的旧金山市与马林县相连，使美国101号公路和加州1号公路跨越海峡。桥上也允许行人和自行车通行，并被划为美国95号自行车路线的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Bardia was fought over three days between 3 and 5 January 1941, as part of Operation Compass, the first military operation of the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. It was the first battle of the war in which an Australian Army formation took part, the first to be commanded by an Australian general and the first to be planned by an Australian staff. Major General Iven Mackay's 6th Division assaulted the strongly held Italian fortress of Bardia, Libya, assisted by air support and naval gunfire, and under the cover of an artillery barrage.

zh.s: 1941年1月3日至5日，巴尔迪亚战役持续三天，是第二次世界大战西部沙漠战役首项军事行动“罗盘行动”的一部分。这是澳大利亚陆军作战编队在这场战争中参加的首战，也是首次由澳大利亚将军指挥、澳大利亚参谋人员规划的战斗。艾文·麦凯少将率领第六师，在空中支援、舰炮及炮兵火力掩护下，进攻意大利军队坚守的利比亚巴尔迪亚要塞。

en.t: The Daily Mail becomes the first major London newspaper to be published on both sides of the Atlantic Ocean
en.s: The Daily Mail, often known simply as the Mail, is a British daily middle-market tabloid-size conservative newspaper founded in 1896 and published in London. Its sister paper The Mail on Sunday was launched in 1982, a Scottish edition was launched in 1947, and an Irish edition in 2006. Content from the paper appears on the MailOnline news website, although the website is managed separately and has its own editor.

zh.t: 《每日邮报》成为首份在大西洋两岸出版的伦敦主要报纸
zh.s: 《每日邮报》通常简称《邮报》，是1896年创办、在伦敦出版的英国保守派大众市场小版面日报。其姊妹报《星期日邮报》于1982年创刊，苏格兰版于1947年推出，爱尔兰版于2006年推出。该报内容也刊登在MailOnline新闻网站上，但网站独立运营，并拥有自己的编辑负责人。

en.s: The Battle of Bure was part of the Battle of the Bulge, which lasted from 3 to 5 January 1945 during the final months of the Second World War. The battle was fought as part of the Allied counterattack to force the Germans from ground that they had captured and which had forced the Allies on the defensive.

zh.s: 比尔战斗是突出部战役的一部分，发生于第二次世界大战接近结束的1945年1月3日至5日。当时德军夺取了一些阵地，迫使盟军转入防御；盟军随后发起反攻，试图将德军逐出这些地区，比尔战斗即为反攻的一环。

en.t: In his State of the Union address, United States President Harry S. Truman unveils his Fair Deal program
en.s: Harry S. Truman (May 8, 1884 – December 26, 1972) was the 33rd president of the United States, serving from 1945 to 1953. As the 34th vice president in 1945, he assumed the presidency upon the death of Franklin D. Roosevelt in April. Truman set up the Marshall Plan to rebuild the badly damaged economy of Western Europe.

zh.t: 美国总统哈里·杜鲁门在国情咨文中提出“公平施政”计划
zh.s: 哈里·S. 杜鲁门（1884年5月8日—1972年12月26日）是美国第33任总统，任期为1945年至1953年。他于1945年担任第34任副总统，并在当年4月富兰克林·D. 罗斯福去世后继任总统。杜鲁门推行马歇尔计划，帮助重建遭受严重破坏的西欧经济。

en.s: The 1956–57 Durand Cup final was the 53rd final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India. It was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Hyderabad City Police on 5 January 1957 at the Delhi Gate Stadium in New Delhi. East Bengal won the final 2–0 to claim their 3rd Durand Cup title.

zh.s: 1957年1月5日，第53届杜兰德杯决赛在印度新德里的德里门体育场举行，由加尔各答劲旅东孟加拉对阵海得拉巴市警察队。杜兰德杯是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。东孟加拉以2比0获胜，第三次夺冠。

en.t: In a speech given to the United States Congress, United States President Dwight D. Eisenhower announces the establishment of what will later be called the Eisenhower Doctrine
en.s: The United States Congress is the legislative branch of the federal government of the United States. It is a bicameral legislature, including a lower body, the U.S. House of Representatives, and an upper body, the U.S. Senate. They both meet in the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. Members of Congress are chosen through direct election, though vacancies in the Senate may be filled by a governor's appointment.

zh.t: 美国总统德怀特·D. 艾森豪威尔向国会发表讲话，宣布后来被称为“艾森豪威尔主义”的政策
zh.s: 美国国会是美国联邦政府的立法机构，实行两院制，由作为下院的众议院和作为上院的参议院组成。两院均在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的美国国会大厦开会。国会议员通过直接选举产生，不过参议院出现空缺时，可以由州长任命人员补缺。

en.s: Presidential elections were held for the first time in the Central African Republic on 5 January 1964. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Movement for the Social Evolution of Black Africa (MESAN) as the sole legal party. Its leader, incumbent President David Dacko, was the only candidate, and won with 99.97% of the vote and a 93.8% turnout.

zh.s: 1964年1月5日，中非共和国首次举行总统选举。当时该国实行一党制，黑非洲社会发展运动是唯一合法政党。该党领袖、现任总统戴维·达科是唯一候选人，以99.97%的得票率获胜，投票率为93.8%。

en.t: The first Alpine Ski World Cup race is held in Berchtesgaden
en.s: The FIS Alpine Ski World Cup is the top international circuit of alpine skiing competitions, launched in 1966 by a group of ski racing friends and experts that included French journalist Serge Lang and the alpine ski team directors from France (Honore Bonnet) and the USA (Bob Beattie). It was soon backed by International Ski Federation president Marc Hodler during the FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 1966 at Portillo, Chile, and became an official FIS event in the spring of 1967 after the FIS Congress at Beirut, Lebanon. The inaugural World Cup race was held on 5 January 1967 in Berchtesgaden, West Germany, a slalom won by Heinrich Messner of Austria.
en.n: This entry records the inaugural World Cup race on January 5, 1967, in West Germany. Other countries that later hosted the series are not locations for this occurrence.

zh.t: 首场高山滑雪世界杯比赛在贝希特斯加登举行
zh.s: 国际雪联高山滑雪世界杯是最高水平的国际高山滑雪系列赛事，由一群滑雪界好友与专家于1966年发起，包括法国记者塞尔日·朗、法国高山滑雪队负责人奥诺雷·博内和美国队负责人鲍勃·比蒂。1966年智利波蒂略世界高山滑雪锦标赛期间，该赛事很快得到国际雪联主席马克·霍德勒的支持。1967年春季，国际雪联在黎巴嫩贝鲁特召开大会后，将其纳入正式赛事。首场世界杯比赛于1967年1月5日在西德贝希特斯加登举行，是一场回转比赛，冠军为奥地利选手海因里希·梅斯纳。
zh.n: 此条记录的是1967年1月5日在西德举行的首场世界杯比赛。此后承办过该系列赛事的其他国家，不是这场比赛的举办地。

en.s: The January Storm, formally known as the January Revolution, was a coup d'état in Shanghai that occurred between 5 January and 23 February 1967, during the Cultural Revolution. The coup, precipitated by the Sixteen Articles and unexpected local resistance towards Maoism in Shanghai, was launched by Maoist rebel factions against the city's party leadership under the directives of the Cultural Revolution Group (CRG) through Maoist leaders such as Zhang Chunqiao, Wang Hongwen and Yao Wenyuan, with backing from Mao Zedong, Kang Sheng, and Jiang Qing.
en.n: The January Storm, formally known as the January Revolution, was a coup d'état in Shanghai that occurred between 5 January and 23 February 1967, during the Cultural Revolution.

zh.s: “一月风暴”正式称为“一月革命”，是文化大革命期间于1967年1月5日至2月23日在上海发生的一场夺权政变。运动受到“十六条”及上海当地意料之外的反毛主义抵制所推动，由毛派造反派针对上海市委领导层发动。中央文革小组通过张春桥、王洪文和姚文元等毛派领导人指挥行动，并得到毛泽东、康生和江青的支持。
zh.n: “一月风暴”正式称为“一月革命”，是文化大革命期间于1967年1月5日至2月23日在上海发生的一场夺权政变。

en.s: Alexander Dubček (Slovak pronunciation: [ˈaleksander ˈduptʂek]; 27 November 1921 – 7 November 1992) was a Slovak statesman who served as the First Secretary of the Presidium of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia (KSČ) (de facto leader of Czechoslovakia) from January 1968 to April 1969 and as Chairman of the Federal Assembly from 1989 to 1992 following the Velvet Revolution.

zh.t: 亚历山大·杜布切克上台
zh.s: 亚历山大·杜布切克（1921年11月27日—1992年11月7日）是斯洛伐克政治家，1968年1月至1969年4月担任捷克斯洛伐克共产党（KSČ）中央委员会主席团第一书记，是捷克斯洛伐克实际领导人。天鹅绒革命后，他于1989年至1992年担任联邦议会主席。

en.s: Ariana Afghan Airlines Flight 701 was a scheduled international flight involved in an aviation accident on 5 January 1969. The incident involved a Boeing 727 aircraft, carrying 62 individuals, that crashed into a residential property during its approach to London Gatwick Airport amidst heavy fog. The accident was primarily attributed to pilot error, specifically the failure to extend the flaps to maintain flight at the final approach speed.

zh.t: 阿里亚纳阿富汗航空701号班机空难
zh.s: 阿里亚纳阿富汗航空701号班机是一班定期国际航班，于1969年1月5日发生空难。一架载有62人的波音727飞机在浓雾中进近伦敦盖特威克机场时，撞上一处住宅。事故主要归因于飞行员失误，具体是未放下襟翼，导致飞机无法在最后进近速度下维持飞行。

en.s: An earthquake occurred in Tonghai, Yunnan province, China at 01:00:41 local time on 5 January 1970 with a moment magnitude of 7.1 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). The strike-slip rupture originated on the Red River Fault, which had not experienced an earthquake above magnitude 7 since 1700. At least 10,000 people were killed, making it one of the deadliest in its decade. The tremor caused between US$5 and $25 million in damage, felt over an area of 8,781 km2 (3,390 sq mi). In Hanoi, North Vietnam, almost 483 km (300 mi) from the epicenter, victims left their homes as the rupture rumbled through the city.

zh.s: 1970年1月5日当地时间凌晨1时0分41秒，中国云南省通海发生矩震级7.1级地震，最大修订麦加利烈度为X度，即极强破坏。地震由红河断裂上的走滑破裂引发，该断裂自1700年以来未曾发生超过7级的地震。至少1万人遇难，使它成为当时十年间死亡人数最多的地震之一。经济损失约为500万至2,500万美元，有感范围达8,781平方公里。距离震中近483公里的北越河内也有明显震感，居民在震动时离开房屋。

en.s: The Tasman Bridge disaster occurred on the evening of 5 January 1975, in Hobart, the capital city of Australia's island state of Tasmania, when a bulk ore carrier travelling up the Derwent River collided with several pylons of the Tasman Bridge, causing a large section of the bridge deck to collapse onto the ship and into the river below. Twelve people were killed, including seven crew on board the ship, and the five occupants of four cars which fell 45 m (150 feet) after driving off the bridge.

zh.s: 1975年1月5日晚，澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州首府霍巴特发生塔斯曼大桥事故。一艘沿德文特河上行的散装矿砂船撞上数座桥墩，导致大段桥面坍塌，砸在船上并落入河中。事故造成12人死亡，包括船上七名船员，以及四辆驶出断桥后坠落45米的汽车中的五名乘员。

en.s: The Kingsmill massacre took place on 5 January 1976 near the village of Kingsmill in south County Armagh, Northern Ireland. Gunmen stopped a minibus carrying eleven Protestant workmen, lined them up alongside it and shot them. Only one victim survived, despite having been shot 18 times. A group calling itself the South Armagh Republican Action Force claimed responsibility. It said the shooting was retaliation for a string of attacks on Catholic civilians in the area by Loyalists, particularly the killing of six Catholics the night before.

zh.s: 1976年1月5日，北爱尔兰阿马郡南部金斯米尔村附近发生屠杀。枪手截停一辆载有11名新教徒工人的小巴，命令他们在车旁排成一列后开枪。只有一人幸存，尽管他身中18枪。一个自称“南阿马共和行动力量”的组织宣称负责，并称此举是报复亲英派在当地对天主教平民的一连串袭击，尤其是前一晚六名天主教徒遇害的事件。

en.t: The Khmer Rouge abolished the Royal Government of National Union of Kampuchea (GRUNK; established in 1970) and promulgated the Constitution of Democratic Kampuchea on 5 January 1976
en.s: Democratic Kampuchea was the official name of the Cambodian state from 1975 to 1979, under the general secretaryship of Pol Pot and the Communist Party of Kampuchea (CPK), commonly known as the Khmer Rouge. The Khmer Rouge's capture of the capital Phnom Penh in 1975 effectively ended the United States-backed Khmer Republic under Prime Minister and later President Lon Nol.

zh.t: 红色高棉废除1970年成立的柬埔寨民族统一王国政府，并于1976年1月5日颁布民主柬埔寨宪法
zh.s: 民主柬埔寨是柬埔寨在1975年至1979年间的正式国名，当时由总书记波尔布特及通常称为红色高棉的柬埔寨共产党（CPK）统治。1975年，红色高棉攻占首都金边，实际上结束了由美国支持、朗诺先后担任总理和总统的高棉共和国。

en.s: The 1991–1992 South Ossetia War (also known as the First South Ossetia War) was fought between Georgian government forces and ethnic Georgian militias on one side and the forces of South Ossetian separatists and Russia on the other. The war ended with a Dagomys Agreement, signed on 24 June 1992, which established a joint peacekeeping force and left South Ossetia divided between the rival authorities.

zh.s: 1991年至1992年南奥塞梯战争又称第一次南奥塞梯战争，交战一方为格鲁吉亚政府军及格鲁吉亚族民兵，另一方为南奥塞梯分离主义武装和俄罗斯军队。战争以1992年6月24日签署的《达戈梅斯协议》结束。协议设立了联合维和部队，南奥塞梯则由相互对立的当局分区控制。

en.t: Somali Civil War: The United States Embassy to Somalia in Mogadishu is evacuated by helicopter airlift days after the outbreak of violence in Mogadishu
en.s: The Somali Civil War (Somali: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Soomaaliya; Arabic: الحرب الأهلية الصومالية al-ḥarb al-’ahliyya aṣ-ṣūmāliyya) is an ongoing civil war that is taking place in Somalia. It grew out of resistance to the military junta led by Siad Barre during the 1980s.

zh.t: 索马里内战：摩加迪沙暴力冲突爆发数日后，美国驻索马里使馆人员由直升机空运撤离
zh.s: 索马里内战（索马里语：Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Soomaaliya；阿拉伯语：الحرب الأهلية الصومالية）是持续发生在索马里的内战，起源于20世纪80年代反对西亚德·巴雷领导的军政府的抵抗运动。

The event took place on January 5, 1996 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. House Party featured the final appearance of tag team the Public Enemy, who had signed contracts with World Championship Wrestling, until their return in January 1999, as well as the final appearance of Tony Stetson.

zh.s: 1996年1月5日，极限冠军摔角联盟（ECW）在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场，举办首届“家庭派对”大型职业摔角赛事，安排多场重点比赛。双人组合Public Enemy已与世界冠军摔角联盟签约，这是他们在1999年1月回归前最后一次亮相ECW。托尼·斯泰森也在这场赛事中最后一次亮相。

en.t: Tel Aviv central bus station massacre
en.s: The Tel Aviv central bus station massacre was an attack which occurred on January 5, 2003 in which two Palestinian suicide bombers blew themselves up outside the Tel Aviv Central Bus Station in Tel Aviv, Israel, killing 23 civilians and injuring over 100.

zh.t: 特拉维夫中央汽车站爆炸惨案
zh.s: 2003年1月5日，两名巴勒斯坦自杀式袭击者在以色列特拉维夫中央汽车站外引爆炸弹，造成23名平民死亡、100多人受伤。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 22 December 2002, with a second round on 5 January 2003. Incumbent President Valdas Adamkus ran for reelection alongside sixteen other candidates, the largest field of presidential candidates in the country's history. Though Adamkus held a large lead over his closest opponent, Rolandas Paksas of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), in the first round of the election, Paksas defeated Adamkus in the second round with 54.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2002年12月22日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于2003年1月5日举行。现任总统瓦尔达斯·阿达姆库斯寻求连任，另有16名候选人参选，是该国历史上总统候选人人数最多的一届。首轮中，阿达姆库斯大幅领先最接近的对手、自由民主党（LDP）的罗兰达斯·帕克萨斯，但帕克萨斯在第二轮以54.71%的选票击败了阿达姆库斯。

en.t: The dwarf planet Eris is discovered by Palomar Observatory-based astronomers, later motivating the International Astronomical Union (IAU) to define the term planet for the first time
en.s: Eris (minor-planet number 136199) is the most massive and second-largest-known dwarf planet in the Solar System. It is a trans-Neptunian object (TNO) in the scattered disk and has a high-eccentricity orbit. Eris was discovered in January 2005 by a Palomar Observatory–based team led by Mike Brown and verified later that year. It was named in September 2006 after the Greco-Roman goddess of strife and discord.

zh.t: 帕洛马天文台团队发现矮行星阋神星，后来促使国际天文学联合会首次明确定义“行星”
zh.s: 阋神星（小行星编号136199）是太阳系中已知质量最大、体积第二大的矮行星，属于离散盘中的海王星外天体（TNO），轨道偏心率很高。迈克·布朗率领的帕洛马天文台团队于2005年1月发现它，并在当年稍后确认。2006年9月，它以希腊—罗马神话中的纷争与不和女神命名。

en.s: Gimry fighting were armed clashed that took place between January 2 – January 5, 2006, near the village of Gimry in the mountainous region of Daghestan.The fighting was part of a larger insurgency in the Northern Caucasus between Russian government forces and local fighters, some linked to Chechen separatist and Islamist groups.

zh.s: 吉姆雷战斗是2006年1月2日至5日在达吉斯坦山区吉姆雷村附近发生的武装冲突，属于北高加索地区更广泛的叛乱活动。交战双方为俄罗斯政府军与当地武装人员，其中一些人与车臣分离主义和伊斯兰主义组织有关联。

en.s: On January 5, 2007, Chinese paramilitary police raided a suspected East Turkestan Islamic Movement (ETIM) training camp in Akto County in the Pamir plateau. A spokesperson for the Xinjiang Public Security Department said that 18 terror suspects were killed and 17 captured. Those captured were either sentenced to death or life imprisonment. The raid also resulted in the death of one Chinese paramilitary officer, Huang Qiang, age 21, and the injury of another officer.

zh.s: 2007年1月5日，中国武警突袭了位于帕米尔高原阿克陶县、疑似由“东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动”设立的训练营。新疆公安厅发言人表示，行动击毙18名恐怖活动嫌疑人、抓获17人。被捕人员后来被判处死刑或无期徒刑。行动中，21岁的武警黄强牺牲，另一名武警受伤。

en.t: 2011 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election
en.s: On January 5, 2011, the first convening of the United States House of Representatives during the 112th United States Congress, and two months after the 2010 U.S. House elections, the incoming House members held an election for its speaker. This was 121st speaker election since the office was created in 1789. Since House Republicans had gained the previously-Democrat-held majority in the 2010 elections, Republican House Leader John Boehner unseated Democratic House Leader Nancy Pelosi as speaker.

zh.s: 2011年1月5日，即美国第112届国会众议院首次开会、2010年众议院选举结束两个月后，新一届众议员举行议长选举。这是该职位于1789年设立以来的第121次选举。共和党在2010年选举中夺取了此前由民主党掌握的多数席位，因此众议院共和党领袖约翰·博纳取代民主党领袖南希·佩洛西，出任议长。

en.s: General elections were held in Bangladesh on 5 January 2014, in accordance with the constitutional requirement that the election must take place within the 90-day period before the expiration of the term of the Jatiyo Sangshad on 24 January 2014. The elections were controversial, with almost all major opposition parties boycotting and 154 of the total 300 seats being uncontested. Around 21 people were killed on election day.

zh.s: 2014年1月5日，孟加拉国举行大选。宪法规定，必须在当届国民议会于2014年1月24日任期届满前的90天内进行选举。这次选举争议很大，几乎所有主要反对党都予以抵制，300个席位中有154席没有竞争者。选举当天约有21人死亡。

en.t: A launch of the communication satellite GSAT-14 aboard the GSLV MK.II D5 marks the first successful flight of an Indian cryogenic engine
en.s: GSAT-14 is an Indian communications satellite launched in January 2014. It replaced the GSAT-3 satellite, which was launched in 2004. GSAT-14 was launched by a Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle Mk.II, which incorporated an Indian-built cryogenic engine on the third stage.

zh.t: GSLV Mk.II D5火箭发射GSAT-14通信卫星，标志印度自制低温发动机首次飞行成功
zh.s: GSAT-14是印度于2014年1月发射的通信卫星，用于接替2004年发射的GSAT-3卫星。GSAT-14由地球同步卫星运载火箭Mk.II型发射，该火箭第三级采用印度自制的低温发动机。

en.t: 2015 New South Wales Labor Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the leadership of the New South Wales branch of the Australian Labor Party, the party of opposition in the New South Wales, was held on 5 January 2015. The election was triggered following the resignation of Opposition Leader John Robertson on 23 December 2014.

en.s: La Copa Junior (2016) (Spanish for "The Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from January 5, 2016 to January 19, 2016 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.

en.s: On 4 January 2018, SPLM-IO rebels loyal to Chan Garang Lual attacked the western parts of Juba, the capital of South Sudan. The raid was part of the South Sudanese Civil War. Once in Juba, the insurgents were reportedly joined by Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) soldiers who were loyal to deposed chief of staff Paul Malong Awan.

en.s: Operation Cartenz's Peace (Indonesian: Operasi Damai Cartenz), formerly Operation Nemangkawi, is a joint-operation conducted by Indonesian National Armed Forces and Indonesian National Police to curb armed separatist rebels in Papua. According to Chief of Papua Regional Police, Mathius Fakhiri, there are currently six active separatist groups located mainly in Papua highlands. While there are two groups which became less active or retired after Operation Nemangkawi.

en.s: The NWA New Years Clash, part of the NWA Pop-Up Event series, was a professional wrestling supercard show that took place on January 5, 2019 at the Wilma Rudolph Event Center in Clarksville, Tennessee and aired as a pay-per-view event on FITE TV on April 12, 2019. This was the second event produced directly under the National Wrestling Alliance banner since Billy Corgan became the new owner of the organization in May 2017, following the NWA 70th Anniversary Show.

zh.s: 2019年1月5日，全国摔角联盟（NWA）在美国田纳西州克拉克斯维尔的威尔玛·鲁道夫活动中心，举办多场重点对决组成的“新年交锋”赛事。这是NWA Pop-Up系列的一部分，随后于4月12日在FITE TV以按次付费方式播出。比利·科根于2017年5月成为NWA新老板后，这是继NWA成立七十周年纪念赛之后，第二场直接以该联盟名义制作的赛事。

en.s: The 2020 MFF Charity Cup (also known as the 2020 MPT Charity Cup for sponsorship reasons) is the 9th Charity Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous National League and Domestic Cup competitions. It was held at YUSC Stadium on 5 January 2020. The match was played between Shan United, champions of the 2019 Myanmar National League and Yangon United, champions of the 2019 General Aung San Shield.

zh.s: 2020年缅甸足协慈善杯因赞助冠名也称2020年MPT慈善杯，是第九届赛事，由上一赛季国家联赛和国内杯赛的冠军参加。比赛于2020年1月5日在仰光联体育场举行，交战双方为2019年缅甸国家足球联赛冠军掸邦联，以及2019年昂山将军盾冠军仰光联。

en.s: The Camp Simba attack was a pre-dawn attack at Magagoni Airfield near Camp Simba on 5 January 2020. The camp is used by Kenyan and U.S. troops and is located near Manda Bay on the mainland of Lamu County, Kenya. The perpetrators were al-Shabaab, a Somalia-based Islamic extremist insurgent group. Approximately 30-40 al-Shabaab militants assaulted Camp Simba, which was home to around 100 US personnel along with an undisclosed number of Kenyan troops.

zh.s: 2020年1月5日黎明前，肯尼亚辛巴营地附近的马加戈尼机场遭到袭击。营地位于肯尼亚拉穆县大陆部分、曼达湾附近，由肯尼亚和美国军队使用。袭击者为总部位于索马里的伊斯兰极端主义叛乱组织青年党。约30至40名青年党武装人员进攻了营地；当时营地内约有100名美方人员，以及人数未公开的肯尼亚部队。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia in December 2019 and January 2020. The decision to call the elections was made by the Croatian Government during its session on 14 November 2019. en.t: 2020 Venezuelan National Assembly Delegated Committee election
en.s: Venezuela’s National Assembly leadership election on 5 January 2020 resulted in rival claims to its presidency. Security forces prevented Juan Guaidó and some other opposition deputies from entering the assembly building. Luis Parra was declared president inside the legislature; opposition deputies later held a separate session and voted to re-elect Guaidó. The outcome was disputed.
en.n: The leadership contest occurred on this date, but the resulting claim to the assembly presidency was disputed.

zh.t: 2020年委内瑞拉国民议会领导机构选举
zh.s: 2020年1月5日，委内瑞拉国民议会领导机构选举引发相互竞争的议长主张。安全部队阻止胡安·瓜伊多及部分反对派议员进入议会大楼。路易斯·帕拉在议会内被宣布为议长；反对派议员随后另行开会，投票让瓜伊多连任。选举结果存在争议。

en.t: Georgia holds the Public Service Commission District 4 runoff
en.s: The 2020 Georgia Public Service Commission election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect two members to the Georgia Public Service Commission, concurrently with the presidential election, as well as both a regular and special election to the U.S. Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州举行公共服务委员会选举，选出两名委员。同日还举行总统选举、美国参议院常规选举和特别选举、美国众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。

en.t: 2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 3, 2020, and on January 5, 2021 (as a runoff), to elect the Class II member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Georgia. en.s: The 2021 Turkish Super Cup (Turkish: TFF Süper Kupa 2021), officially known as the 2021 Turkcell Super Cup (Turkish: Turkcell Süper Kupa 2021) for sponsorship reasons, was the 48th edition of the Turkish Super Cup since its establishment as Presidential Cup in 1966, the annual Turkish football match contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and cup competitions (or cup runner-up in case the league- and cup-winning club is the same). The game was played on 5 January 2022 between Beşiktaş and Antalyaspor.

zh.s: 2021年土耳其超级杯（TFF Süper Kupa 2021）因赞助冠名正式称为2021年Turkcell超级杯。这是该赛事自1966年以总统杯之名创办以来的第48届。比赛每年由上一赛季土耳其顶级联赛冠军与杯赛冠军参加；若同一俱乐部同时赢得联赛与杯赛，则由杯赛亚军参赛。本届比赛于2022年1月5日举行，由贝西克塔斯对阵安塔利亚体育。

en.s: The 2023 Sinaloa unrest or The Second Black Thursday began on January 5, 2023, following the arrest of Ovidio Guzmán, son of jailed drug lord Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán, sparking a wave of violence in the state of Sinaloa. In retaliation for the arrest of Ovidio Guzmán, cartel members blocked highways with burning vehicles and began attacks against the armed forces.

en.s: Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by Alaska Airlines from Portland International Airport in Portland, Oregon, to Ontario International Airport in Ontario, California. Shortly after takeoff on January 5, 2024, a door plug on the Boeing 737 MAX 9 aircraft blew out, causing an uncontrolled decompression of the aircraft. The aircraft returned to Portland for an emergency landing.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加航空1282号班机是从美国俄勒冈州波特兰国际机场，飞往加利福尼亚州安大略国际机场的定期国内客运航班。2024年1月5日起飞不久，执飞的波音737 MAX 9客机一块舱门塞突然脱落，导致机舱失控减压。飞机随后返回波特兰紧急降落。

en.s: The 2024 New Year's Revolution, promoted as SmackDown: New Year's Revolution, was a professional wrestling television special produced by the American promotion WWE. It was the fourth New Year's Revolution and aired as a special episode of Friday Night SmackDown on Fox. It took place on January 5, 2024, at the Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, held for wrestlers from the promotion's SmackDown brand division.

zh.s: 2024年1月5日，WWE在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的罗杰斯竞技场，为SmackDown品牌选手举办职业摔角电视特别节目“新年革命”，宣传名称为“SmackDown：新年革命”。这是第四届同名赛事，以《周五晚SmackDown》特别一期的形式在福克斯电视网播出。

en.s: The 2024 Trophée des Champions was the 29th edition of the French super cup. The match was contested by Paris Saint-Germain, the winners of the 2023–24 Ligue 1 and 2023–24 Coupe de France titles, and Monaco, the runners-up of the 2023–24 Ligue 1. Paris Saint-Germain won the match 1–0 for their record thirteenth Trophée des Champions title.

zh.s: 2024年法国超级杯是第29届赛事，由同时赢得2023—24赛季法甲和法国杯冠军的巴黎圣日耳曼，对阵同赛季法甲亚军摩纳哥。巴黎圣日耳曼以1比0获胜，第13次夺得法国超级杯，刷新该赛事的夺冠次数纪录。
